confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'strongly suggests a blown thermal cut-out' is hedged, so not a confident definitive claim

unjustifiedPart.evidence: 'Order the complete heater element assembly with thermostats/TCO already fitted' without any testing

compatibilityWithoutEvidence.evidence: 'Colour variants (DV7110W, DV7110S, etc.) usually take the same part'

rationale: The assistant correctly tied the clogged hose to a likely blown thermal cut-out and gave sensible advice to unplug, read the rear label and open the panel. However, it told the customer to order the full heater assembly without any continuity test, and it asserted colour-variant compatibility without the full model. It never suggested an engineer for a customer who cannot test components, and its first-turn suggestions of model-number formats and a 20-30 ohm element reading were also unsupported.
